## Load all data

this uses alldata from univariate network analysis script; specify path appropriately 

```{r}
alldata = readRDS("alldata_reframe-detail.rds")
```

load template-recall RSA files: 

```{r}
subjects <- list.files(path='/Volumes/memolab/Data/Behavioral_Online/reframe-details/detail_script_files/rsa-encret/',full.names=TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = 'timepoint-rsa')
rsadata  = do.call(rbind, lapply(subjects, function(x) {read.csv(x, header = TRUE)}))

rsadata <- rsadata %>%
  filter(ROI != "none")

rsadata$ROI <- as.factor(rsadata$ROI)
rsadata$videoName <- as.factor(rsadata$videoName)
rsadata$periodLabel <- as.factor(rsadata$periodLabel)
# rsadata$trial <- as.integer(rsadata$trial) # changed to troubleshoot
# rsadata$subID <- as.factor(rsadata$subID) # changed to troubleshoot 



rsadata <- rsadata %>%
  select(subID,trial,ROI,videoName,periodLabel,zWithin,zBetween,zDifference)
```


load retrieval stability RSA files:

```{r}
subjects <- list.files(path='/Volumes/memolab/Data/Behavioral_Online/reframe-details/detail_script_files/retstab_rsa/',full.names=TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = 'timepoint-rsa')
rsadata.stability  = do.call(rbind, lapply(subjects, function(x) {read.csv(x, header = FALSE)}))

colnames(rsadata.stability) = c("subID", "ROI", "trialID", "cueWord", "videoName", "run", "trial", "regulationImg", "regulationActivity", "reminderImg", "reminderActivity", "nVox", "periodLabel", "zWithin", "zBetween", "zDifference")

rsadata.stability <- rsadata.stability %>%
  filter(ROI != "none")

rsadata.stability$ROI <- as.factor(rsadata.stability$ROI)
rsadata.stability$videoName <- as.factor(rsadata.stability$videoName)
rsadata.stability$periodLabel <- as.factor(rsadata.stability$periodLabel)
# rsadata.stability$trial <- as.integer(rsadata.stability$trial)
# rsadata.stability$subID <- as.factor(rsadata.stability$subID)



rsadata.stability <- rsadata.stability %>%
  mutate(zWithin.stab = zWithin,
         zBetween.stab = zBetween,
         zDifference.stab = zDifference) %>%
  select(subID,trial,ROI,videoName,periodLabel,zWithin.stab,zBetween.stab,zDifference.stab)
```



## Combine with trial information
```{r eval=FALSE}
rsadata <- left_join(rsadata,alldata,by=c("subID","trial","ROI","videoName","periodLabel")) 
rsadata <- left_join(rsadata,rsadata.stability,by=c("subID","trial","ROI","videoName","periodLabel"))
rsadata <- left_join(rsadata,rsadata.avg3,by=c("subID","trial","ROI","videoName","periodLabel"))
rsadata <- rsadata %>% filter(!is.na(eventDets))
rm(rsadata.stability)

```


Using only remembered trials 
```{r}
nonrem = rsadata %>% filter(conditionName == "remember") # not used here, used when looking at all trials 
rsadata =rsadata %>% filter(remembered==1,conditionName == "remember")
```


```{r}
include_networks = c("DefaultA","DefaultB","DefaultC", "HIPP", "AMYG")

rsadata %>%
  filter(network %in% include_networks) %>%
  group_by(subID,trial,network,eventDets, visualDets,conditionName,valenceCategory) %>%
  summarize(zDifference = mean(zDifference,na.rm=TRUE),
            zDifference.stab = mean(zDifference.stab,na.rm=TRUE))%>%
  ungroup() -> network.data
```



# Analysis: Template-recall similarity RSA 
## Results: overall reactivation test 

Testing overall event specific reactivation for each of the 3 networks.  
Average within-network for each subject, get the zdifference for each subject, One-sample t-test for the zdifference against zero. 

```{r}
rsadata %>% 
  filter(
         network %in% include_rois) %>%
  mutate(network = factor(network,levels=include_rois)) %>%
  group_by(subID,ROI,network,periodLabel) %>% # average across trials
  summarize(meanActivity = mean(zDifference,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(subID,network,periodLabel) %>% # average across ROIs
  summarize(meanNet = mean(meanActivity)) -> data_ttest
```

```{r}
results <- data_ttest %>%
  group_by(network) %>%
  summarise(t_test = list(t.test(meanNet, mu = 0))) %>%
  mutate(tidy_results = map(t_test, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(tidy_results)

print(results)
```


## Set up mixed model 

```{r}
model.stats.rsa1 <- data.frame()

# define function
detail_emo_neuref <- function(curROI,model.stats) {
  
  # RECALL
  roiData <- network.data %>% filter(network %in% curROI)
  roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory, levels=c("neu", "neg", "pos"))
  full.model <- lmer(zDifference ~ visualDets*valenceCategory+eventDets*valenceCategory+ (1|subID), data = roiData)
  print(tab_model(full.model,title="RSA detail x emotion, neutral reference",
            file=paste0("/Volumes/memolab/Data/Behavioral_Online/reframe-details/detail_script_files/outfiles/network_",curROI,"rsa_detail_emo_neuref.html")))

  p <- plot_model(full.model, show.values = TRUE, show.p = TRUE,
           value.offset = .3, vline.color = "gray30",
           colors=c("lightskyblue","steelblue"), type = "std") + ylim(c(-.3,.3)) +
    ggtitle(curROI) +
  my_theme()
  print(p)
  
  
    stats <- data.frame(summary(full.model)$coefficients[2:nrow(summary(full.model)$coefficients),])
  stats <- mutate(stats,ROI=curROI)
  model.stats <- rbind(model.stats,stats)
  
  return(model.stats)
}
```

Running the model for DMN A, B, C 
```{r}
model.stats.rsa1 <- detail_emo_neuref("DefaultA",model.stats.rsa1)
model.stats.rsa1 <- detail_emo_neuref("DefaultB",model.stats.rsa1)
model.stats.rsa1 <- detail_emo_neuref("DefaultC",model.stats.rsa1)
```

### Figure 4c (template-recall interaction)


```{r}
curROI <- c("DefaultC")
roiData <- network.data %>% filter(network %in% curROI)
roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory, levels = c("pos", "neu", "neg"))

full.model <- lmer(zDifference ~ visualDets * valenceCategory + eventDets * valenceCategory + (1 | subID), data = roiData)
tab_model(full.model)

# Generate the base plot
p <- plot_model(full.model, 
                type = "pred", 
                terms = c("eventDets", "valenceCategory"))

# Customize the plot
p + 
  labs(x = "Narrative details recalled", y = "MT template-recall similarity") + 
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Valence",
    values = c("pos" = "#6CCA74", "neu" = "#688FD9", "neg" = "#D33E1E"),
    labels = c("Positive", "Neutral", "Negative")
  )+
  scale_fill_manual(
  name = "Valence",
  values = c("pos" = "#6CCA74", "neu" = "#688FD9", "neg" = "#D33E1E"),
  labels = c("Positive", "Neutral", "Negative")
)+
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
   panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = .5), 
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = .5), 
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10), 
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      legend.text=element_text(size=8),
```

```{r}
rsadata %>%
  filter(network=="DefaultA" | network=="DefaultB" | network=="DefaultC") %>%
  mutate(net = case_when(network=='DefaultA' ~ 'Core midline',
                         network=='DefaultB' ~ 'Dorsomedial',
                         network=='DefaultC' ~ 'Medial temporal')) %>%
  group_by(subID,net) %>%
  summarize(rsa = mean(zDifference.stab,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=net,y=rsa,color=net)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill=net),alpha=.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("slateblue","lightsteelblue","slateblue4")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("slateblue","lightsteelblue","slateblue4")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.02, 0.06)) +
  ylab('Recall-recall reactivation') + 
   theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10), 
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = .5), 
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = .5), 
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),

    plot.title = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank())-> overall_stability
```

```{r}
include_rois <- c("DefaultA","DefaultB","DefaultC")
rsadata %>% 
  filter(
         network %in% include_rois) %>%
  mutate(network = factor(network,levels=include_rois)) %>%
  group_by(subID,ROI,network,periodLabel) %>% # average across trials
  summarize(meanActivity = mean(zDifference.stab,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(subID,network,periodLabel) %>% # average across ROIs
  summarize(meanNet = mean(meanActivity)) -> data_ttest

results <- data_ttest %>%
  group_by(network) %>%
  summarise(t_test = list(t.test(meanNet, mu = 0))) %>%

print(results)
```

```{r}

include_rois <- c("DefaultA","DefaultB","DefaultC")

# Summarize data
rsadata %>%
  filter(network %in% include_rois) %>%
  mutate(network = factor(network,levels=include_rois)) %>%
  group_by(subID,ROI,network,periodLabel,valenceCategory) %>% # average across trials
  summarize(meanActivity = mean(zDifference.stab,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(subID,network,periodLabel,valenceCategory) %>% # average across ROIs 
  summarize(meanNet = mean(meanActivity)) -> subdata

subdata %>%
  filter(valenceCategory=="neu") %>%
  mutate(meanNeutral = meanNet) %>%
  select(subID,network,periodLabel,meanNeutral) -> subdata.neu

subdata %>%
  left_join(subdata.neu,by=c("subID","network","periodLabel")) %>%
  mutate(valenceDiff = meanNet - meanNeutral) -> subdata

subdata %>%
  group_by(network,periodLabel,valenceCategory) %>% # then average across subjects
  summarize(meanAct = mean(meanNet),
            seAct = se(meanNet)) -> meandata

network_names <- list(
  'DMN-A'="Core midline",
  'DMN-B'="Dorsomedial",
  'DMN-C'="Medial temporal"
)

network_labeller <- function(variable,value){
  return(network_names[value])
}

subdata %>%
  ggplot(aes(y=meanNet,x=valenceCategory,color=valenceCategory,fill=valenceCategory)) + 
  facet_grid(.~network,   labeller = network_labeller) +
  # add a violin plot
  # geom_violin(#draw_quantiles = 0.5, # adds a line at median (50%) score
  #             alpha = 0.4) + 
  # add individual data points
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.75) +
  # add a boxplot
  geom_boxplot(width = .5, #0.25, 
               fill = "white", 
               alpha = 0.75, 
               #fatten = 0, # removes the median line
               outlier.alpha = 0) + 
  # add a point that represents the mean
  #stat_summary(fun = mean, 
  #             geom = "point", 
  #             size = 2) + 
  ggtitle("Network activity by valence") + 
   ylab("Recall pattern stability") + # for the y axis label  
   xlab("Valence") +
  # Set fill colors for the bars and specify legend labels
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("neg" = "#e3401a",  # Red for negative
                               "neu" = "#1f78b4",   # Blue for neutral
                               "pos" = "#33a02c"),  # Green for positive
                    labels = c("neg" = "negative", "neu" = "neutral", "pos" = "positive"),
                    name = "Valence") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("neg" = "#e3401a",  # Red for negative
                               "neu" = "#1f78b4",   # Blue for neutral
                               "pos" = "#33a02c"),  # Green for positive
                    labels = c("neg" = "negative", "neu" = "neutral", "pos" = "positive"),
                    name = "Valence") + 
  my_theme() + theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
```
